title: Alphabet reports Q3 revenue up 25% YoY to $127.6B, Google Cloud revenue up 103% to $30.7B, and Google Services revenue up 11% to $96.3B (Alphabet)
summary: Alphabet: Alphabet reports Q3 revenue up 25% YoY to $127.6B, Google Cloud revenue up 103% to $30.7B, and Google Services revenue up 11% to $96.3B — MOUNTAIN VIEW, Calif. - October 28, 2026 - Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ: GOOG, GOOGL) today announced financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
